messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired for service=redwood-runtime-high-latency | severity=critical | incident=INC-8412 | policy=oncall-sre-chain

pagerduty-bot: Primary oncall @sara notified (sms, push).

sara: seeing the page, heading in to check. brb :coffee:

incident-bot: No ack from @sara after 2m, escalating to secondary @jamal

pagerduty-bot: Paging @jamal (call + push). status: phone DND, push timed out.

jamal: phone is on DND, getting on laptop now, my commute is slow, will join in 2m

incident-bot: Secondary escalation timeout. Escalating to manager @claire

claire: I'm awake, checking blips. If primary+secondary can't ack, will join bridge in 5.

matt: brief status: product-facing API latency spiked ~120s p95 for >10% of requests, customers affected: "acme-payments", "edge-analytics". Rolling errors in logs: "kv-cache-miss overload" across gpu-pool-a.

sara: confirmed logs look like KV cache thrashing after rollout. putting temporary routing to fallback-model-v1b.

matt: running command to drain new traffic to fallback:
```
# redirect 10% traffic to fallback for safety
curl -X POST https://console.api/redwood/route -d '{"service":"runtime","traffic_split":{"fallback-model-v1b":0.1}}'
```

jamal: acked incident 1847654321 :thumbsup: joining zoom: https://zoom/abc123

incident-bot: PagerDuty ack recorded by jamal at 1847654338

matt: scaled up pool gpu-pool-a by +2 instances (autoscaler didn't trigger fast enough). watching metrics.

sara: added temporary rate limit for heavy customers: set per-customer qps cap to 50

claire: noting customer impact: acme-payments saw ~30s higher lat for checkout, we should offer SLA credits if confirmed. assigning owner @matt to contact AMs.

matt: creating incident ticket: INC-8412 in tracker and jira https://jira/REDWOOD-8412. Will DM @customer-success for outreach.

sara: mitigation looks stable, p95 down to 220ms, errors back to baseline. keeping the page open for 15m observation.

matt: root cause hypothesis: KV cache eviction after canary rollout + compaction bug, triggers heavy kv misses causing GPU stalls. will revert canary and patch compaction.

incident-bot: PagerDuty escalation policy complete: manager acknowledged at 1847654355

jamal: leaving short post-incident note in ops-runbook and adding watch on kv-eviction-rate metric.

claire: good work. Please schedule postmortem, include timeline and customer impact, add retro actions: (1) tighter canary ramping, (2) autoscaler tuning, (3) PD routing fallback test.

matt: created postmortem draft https://docs/redwood/incidents/INC-8412-draft.md

sara: resolved: reverted canary at 1847654380, postmortem owner @matt. closing page after observation window.

incident-bot: Incident 1847654321 marked RESOLVED. Summary: secondary unreachable due to DND, manager escalation mitigated, mitigation was traffic split + scale + rollback. We'll follow up with customer outreach and PM.

claire: filing follow-up: schedule a drill to validate PD escalation chain within 48h. :calendar:
